content:
morgan: Heads-up — after the v2.12 rollout we're seeing ~30-45% token/sec drop on low-p99 traffic buckets. Started ~10:03 UTC, correlated with merge of feat/ctx-prefetch-affinity (sha: b4f9a1c).
ken: Ugh. Where are you seeing it? prod or canary?
morgan: Prod, also reproducible in a small staging cluster when replaying trace. Baseline token/sec ~120k/s, now ~70-85k/s for same load. Latency p95 up ~40ms.
lia: Anything in the runtime logs? kernel picks? batching changes?
morgan: Quick dump from profiler attached:
```
--- sample profile ---
ctb: avg drain latency +14ms
batcher: more small batches (60% increase)
kernel_select: fallback to memcpy-path (memcpy-heavy) on ~18% of batches
kv_cache: hitrate unchanged but warmup latencies spiked
--- end ---
```
sam: memcpy-path fallback usually suggests our kernel affinity heuristic flipped to conservative fallback. Could be the prefetch heuristic change.
morgan: The merge touched prefetch stride and kernel_affinity ordering. I ran `perf` and saw large memcpy bandwidth usage during coalescing.
ken: CI had a perf job that flagged a small regression on that branch, but it was marked flaky and got merged? @ci-bot any record?
ci-bot: Perf job 2026-03-16T23:47 flagged token/sec -18% on macrotask sim. Status: marked flaky by reviewer (id: ops). Merge proceeded.
lia: That explains it. Flaky shouldn't bypass perf flag without owner acknowledgement.
ops: I approved the merge because functional tests were green; I didn't realize perf was still flagged. My bad.
sam: We should bisect to the exact commit in the PR. Can someone run git-bisect across the branch commits?
morgan: Started bisect on a staging replay. Preliminary: the change that bumps small-batch flush threshold (commit 3c2d9e) reduces batching opportunities, and combined with kernel_affinity reorder (commit b4f9a1c) triggers memcpy fallback. Both together amplify token/sec drop.
ken: So it's an interaction, not single root. Do we have repro with only one of the commits?
morgan: Yes — with only 3c2d9e, token/sec drops ~12%. With only b4f9a1c, token/sec drops ~10% and memcpy fallback shows up. Together ~40%.
lia: Good triage. Immediate mitigation options? revert whole PR or apply targeted revert?
sam: Targeted revert of kernel_affinity reorder first — that should stop memcpy fallback and restore kernel path. Kernel change is riskier than flush threshold tweak.
ops: Can we do a configuration flag toggle so we don't need code revert and can flip at runtime?
ken: We have a runtime knob for affinity strategy `AFFINITY_POLICY` and `CTB_SMALL_FLUSH_MS`. We can flip `AFFINITY_POLICY=legacy` on prod clusters as emergency and then tune `CTB_SMALL_FLUSH_MS` back. Ops can push via rollout.
ops: On it. Pushing AFFINITY_POLICY=legacy to prod now.
dev-bot: Deploy started for affinity toggle to prod cluster us-west-1.
(5m later)
dev-bot: Deploy finished.
morgan: After toggle, token/sec back to ~115-125k/s in the impacted buckets. p95 returning to baseline. Looks promising.
lia: Great. Next step: revert kernel_affinity commit in a follow-up PR and backport fix, then re-evaluate small-batch threshold change separately.
sam: Also add a non-flaky gating on CI perf job for merge queues when kernel-affinity or batching heuristics change.
ci-bot: Noted. Will create CI ticket and mark job as required for changes touching runtime/kernel or ctb code paths. Ticket #CI-9142.
ken: Assigning follow-ups: morgan will prepare bisect + perf report with microbench scripts. lia will draft PR to revert kernel_affinity reorder. ops will coordinate config toggle rollback plan. sam will add CI gate ticket.
morgan: I'll attach the replay scripts and perf traces to the issue. Quick note: KV cache warmup latencies spiked because small-batch flush increases empty-slot churn and leads to less effective prefix caching; worth evaluating caching heuristics too.
lia: Agreed. We'll open a follow-up to assess KV cache policy alongside batching heuristics.
ops: Marking rollout HOLD for v2.12 until kernel-affinity revert lands and perf CI passes.
ken: Thanks all. Please paste links to the PRs/issues here when ready.
morgan: PR draft: https://git.redwood/rt/merge_revert/1234 (WIP)
lia: CI ticket: https://git.redwood/ci/tickets/9142
sam: I'll follow up with a short retro on the flaky-perf workflow. :eyes:
morgan: Filing perf report now, will @mention the reviewers once ready.
